additional_info.subject: RE: ID0425182-DC/Si-D/GR-[MP / R6 170002080] Charging issue and CPO Error CRM:02698000156
additional_info.body:
Dear
Olympia Peratsaki,
Hope you are doing well.
We have reviewed the logs based on the provided timestamp and identified that
Outlet 2 went out of order
due to a communication issue. Specifically, the logs indicate the following:
SECC: No communication for 750 ms
Immediately after, the outlet showed the error:
"vendorErrorCode": "modbus0 is not connected"
However, communication was restored within a few seconds, and the outlet returned to
Available
mode.
2025-05-10T05:22:14.953293+00:00 [FW060103G1] swcpu [user:debug] [4127] [MBC] DC2: SECC: no communication for 750ms
2025-05-10T05:22:17.793897+00:00 [FW060103G1] sicharge-cp [local0:info] sicharge-cp-backend/45e34c7ac2ad[639]: OCPP: Send command: StatusNotification (b6054c8f-e553-492f-b676-9e6bd75172ad) - {"connectorId":2,"errorCode":"OtherError","status":"Faulted","vendorId":"SICHARGE D","vendorErrorCode":"modbus0 is not connected"}
2025-05-10T05:22:19.797165+00:00 [FW060103G1] sicharge-cp [local0:info] sicharge-cp-backend/45e34c7ac2ad[639]: OCPP: Send command: StatusNotification (2c15a6d8-67aa-4065-b0e7-bd1f8bcfbe66) - {"connectorId":2,"errorCode":"NoError","status":"Available"}
We kindly request you to review the attached logs to observe the
sequence of events
that led to this incident.
Additionally, we noticed that a few
error flags still persist
, indicating potential underlying issues. Therefore, we recommend planning a
site intervention
to address these residual errors and ensure system stability.
Additional Observations:
We also observed that the following error flags are still persisting:
MCBs_FC18_FC20_FC20_FC21
Mainfan_GQ1 (Ok Signal Lost)
Given this, we recommend
carrying spares
for the following components during the site intervention, in case replacement is required:
Mainfan_GQ1
MCBs: FC18, FC20, FC21
Additionally, kindly refer to the
Knowledge Article (KA)
related to
Mainfan_GQ1
for further guidance on diagnostics and replacement procedures.
Knowledge Article: Knowledge Article for ISP: Emobility_SICD_HW_FAN_Error Flag_OK Signal Lost -
Knowledge Article: Knowledge Article for ISP: Emobility_SICD_HW_Mainfan_GQ1_Ok Signal Lost-Fan rotation disabled -
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team - Abhinav Malokar
